positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed a tool for localized image labeling. Integrated it with a YOLO architecture for optical character recognition.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed, tested and deployed backend software for warehouse execution systems.

positions.title: Mobile Security Research (REU)
positions.description: Conducted research investigating the occurrence of mobile data leaks among android devices as well as techniques to handle these leaks. I conducted this research under my advisor Professor Qiben Yan of the Computer Science department as part of the NSF funded Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU).

honors.title: Awarded Dean's List both Freshman and Sophomore Year
